description: This file defines the CommandInterface, an interface in the AWS SDK for PHP that encapsulates command objects responsible for creating HTTP requests and processing responses. It specifies methods for parameter conversion, retrieving command names, checking parameters, and obtaining handler lists.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the command parameters to an array.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the command.

methods.name: hasParam
methods.description: Checks if the command has a specific parameter by name.

methods.name: getHandlerList
methods.description: Retrieves the handler list used to transfer the command.
